title: Illinois & Chicago Elections Feed
description: Aggregate document produced by actions/scrape-elections and consumed by docs/src/dashboard/elections.html. It holds the offices/races on upcoming Illinois and Chicago ballots (Chicago citywide, Alderperson wards 1-50, CPS board, Police District Councils, and — as coverage expands — Cook County, suburban, judicial and statewide offices) together with the candidates running for each. Like the hearings feed, this is a rolling near-future window, not point-in-time bill metadata; the Pages deploy refreshes it twice daily. Candidate rosters are populated best-effort from official sources (ISBE 'Who Is Running', the Chicago Board of Elections, the Cook County Clerk); a race with no confirmed candidates yet carries an empty list and a link to its official source rather than a guess.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this document was built (data-lineage marker for the dashboard 'as of' badge).

source.description: Human-readable provenance shown in the dashboard footer.

jurisdictions.description: Election authorities whose races this document covers, with the official candidate-list source.

code.description: Short jurisdiction key, e.g. chicago, cps, cook, il.

authority.description: The election authority that runs and lists these races, e.g. 'Chicago Board of Elections'.

source_url.description: Official candidate-list / who-is-running page for this authority.

counts.description: Race count per jurisdiction code (convenience for the dashboard).

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. chicago-mayor, chicago-alderperson-ward-01, cps-board-member-1a, chicago-police-district-council-014. Idempotent across runs; feed filenames derive from it.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code this race belongs to (matches a jurisdictions[].code).

office.description: Office title as commonly named, e.g. 'Mayor', 'Alderperson', 'CPS Board Member', 'Police District Councilmember'.

office_group.description: Grouping used by the dashboard's section headers.

district.description: District / ward / subdistrict label, e.g. 'Ward 1', 'Subdistrict 1A', 'District 14'. Null for citywide offices.

is_citywide.description: True for offices elected by the whole city/authority (Mayor, Clerk, Treasurer, CPS Board President).

ballot_date.description: Date this race appears on the ballot, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, when known (e.g. 2026-11-03 for CPS 2026; 2027-02-23 for the Chicago 2027 municipal general). Null when the date isn't set yet.

partisan.description: True if the race is partisan (candidates carry a party); Chicago municipal and CPS/PDC races are non-partisan.

seats.description: Number of seats elected in this race (usually 1).

incumbent_status.description: How the current officeholder came to the seat, when relevant to 'why this race exists' (e.g. CPS seats that were appointed vs. already elected).

why_note.description: Short plain-English note on why this race exists or what's notable — especially CPS 2026 (the hybrid board ending, appointed vs. voter-elected seats) and first-ever elected offices.

status.description: Where the race is in the election cycle.

official_list_url.description: Official candidate-list / who-is-running page for this specific race or authority.

candidates.description: Candidates for this race. Empty when no candidate has been confirmed from an official source yet.

source.description: Origin authority/host, e.g. 'Chicago Board of Elections' or 'Illinois State Board of Elections'.

name.description: Name as it will appear on the ballot.

office.description: Office sought (echoes the race office; helps when a feed lists candidates across races).

incumbent.description: True if the candidate currently holds this seat. Null when unknown/unverified.

incumbency.description: If an incumbent, how they hold the seat.

party.description: Party, for partisan races only; null for non-partisan races.

filing_date.description: Date the candidate filed nominating papers, ISO YYYY-MM-DD when known.

photo_url.description: Official candidate photo URL, when published by the authority.

source.description: Where this candidate record was read (host or authority).
